facts.fact: 旧情人 Sean 没敲门，于 11:59 a.m. 直接走进 Billie 的新住处，手里带着两大杯咖啡，来帮她把沙发运进屋。
facts.anchor: Sean walks straight through the front door at 11:59 a.m. without knocking and with two large coffees in hand.

facts.fact: Billie 拆箱翻出与前夫 Graham 的私奔婚礼照：她捧着花束、两人相视而笑；她自责结婚太年轻，婚姻注定难长久。
facts.anchor: The photo of Graham and me that Sean mentioned, is sitting at the top of the second box I open.

facts.fact: Sean 为前一晚先说出仍爱她、随后又离开而道歉，承认情绪盖过了理智，并告诉 Billie 她什么都不用回应。
facts.anchor: I’m just going to go right out and say it—I’m so sorry about last night.

facts.fact: 挚友 Maggie 自她离开纽约后天天发短信催她回去，生日就在下周；Sean 主动提出陪她去纽约、说母亲下周能看店，Billie 提自己住过 almost nine years，坚持由她来买票。
facts.anchor: She has been begging me to be there for her birthday since before I even left. It’s next week.

facts.fact: 父亲 Wesley 意外出现在车道台阶上，拎着一份披萨和一升汽水（Sprite 是她的最爱），主动邀 Sean 共进午餐，还让他别叫 Mr. Sloane、直接叫 Wesley。
facts.anchor: He’s standing on the steps to the house with a pizza and a liter of soda.

facts.fact: 被父亲 Wesley 问到从军经历时，Sean 透露最亲密的战友 Nolan 死于伊拉克，此后感觉再也不一样，他因此退役。
facts.anchor: My closest buddy Nolan…he died when we were in Iraq. It never felt the same after that. That’s why I resigned.

facts.fact: 在波特兰机场登机后，怕坐飞机的 Billie 为 six hours 航程紧张，Sean 十指相扣安抚并答应陪她看电影；她旁边的靠窗位到最后无人认领。
facts.anchor: I know six hours seems like a long time, but it goes by quickly, I promise.
